newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Guards kill five in Addis Ababa jail break.
newsitem.headline: Guards kill five in Addis Ababa jail break.

text.p: Guards shot dead five prisoners attempting to escape from Addis Ababa's main prison and captured nine others, Ethiopian state television said late on Monday.
It quoted police as saying some prisoners scaled the walls of the nearby headquarters of the Organisation of African Unity (OAU) during Monday's jail break in the capital but were later captured.
OAU sources said police officers did not enter the OAU compound though three prisoners were inside. They said no shots were fired inside the headquarters though shooting was heard in the area.
